title: Serif display, sans UI
summary: Headlines in a text serif with tight tracking; everything you interact with in a neutral sans. The serif carries the voice, the sans does the work.
use_when: Signaling craft or editorial taste in a technical category.
avoid_when: Products where everything is UI; the serif ends up on nothing.
recipe:
h1, h2 { font-family: var(--font-serif); font-weight: 400–500; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.0–1.04; }
body, button, input { font-family: var(--font-sans); }
specimen_html:
serif carries the voice

Software that reads like a good book.

sans does the work

evidence.measured: Families by text share: IvyOra Display 92%, Figtree 8%
Families by text share: ui-sans-serif 51%, Iowan Old Style 29%, ui-monospace 20%
